Robust count invariant (`runWithTenant(` count ≥ HTTP-handler count per file; comment-stripped source; portable ERE — no `\b`, so it runs on BSD grep too), verified **both ways**: green on HEAD, and a deliberately-dropped wrap on the 3-handler `[contactId]` route fails with "3 HTTP handler(s) but only 2 runWithTenant( wrap(s)". shellcheck + `bash -n` + YAML-parse all clean. **Still deferred:** CrmContact policy (blocked — CRM parked, off-prod) + the broader compound-where org-bind lint (IMPACT §7 #1 — flags `where:{id}` *mutations* without an org bind; a different, still-open guard from this one).

- **Event-wide attendee cap (Option B) — Settings "Maximum Attendees" now ENFORCED (July 24, 2026, commit `0b4be2f4` + review fixes)** — The dormant Settings → Registration "Maximum Attendees" input is now a real, race-safe event-wide cap. **Schema:** `Event.maxAttendees Int?` (null = unlimited) + `Event.seatCount` enforcement counter (additive+idempotent migration `20260724120000`); the legacy never-enforced `settings.maxAttendees` JSON key is deliberately NOT migrated (silently activating a forgotten value could block a live event — organizers re-enter the cap). **The invariant** ([registration-seat.ts](src/lib/registration-seat.ts) `holdsEventSeat()`): an event seat is held IFF the registration holds a ticket/tier seat — non-CANCELLED + IN_PERSON + not a speaker companion; virtual + faculty never consume the cap, PENDING/WAITLISTED do (owner decisions). `planSeatTransition` gained `eventDelta: -1|0|1` and the shared `applyRegistrationTransition` applies it centrally (requires `eventId` — the compiler swept all callers). **Helpers** ([registration-seat-db.ts](src/lib/registration-seat-db.ts)): `claimEventSeats` (RAW conditional `UPDATE … WHERE seatCount + n <= maxAttendees` — Prisma updateMany can't compare columns; null cap increments but never blocks), `releaseEventSeats` (guarded ≥, never below 0), `incrementEventSeatsOverselling` (unguarded + oversold report). **Enforcement:** hard-blocks public register + single manual/MCP creates + single reactivations (`EVENT_FULL` — 400 public / 409 REST update / MCP tool error); CSV/contacts/EventsAir imports + MCP bulk proceed past the cap with an `import:event-oversold` / `bulk-reactivate-event-oversold` warn (owner decision: imports bypass); DELETE + cancel release; bulk-type is a no-op by construction (the person stays ONE attendee). **Recompute-on-set:** the event PUT accepts top-level `maxAttendees` (0→null); saving a cap recounts `seatCount` from row-truth under a `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` row lock in the SAME tx (self-healing — also what makes the blue-green deploy window safe: drift can only accumulate while no cap exists, and setting one recomputes first), and a cap below the current count is rejected (400 `EVENT_CAP_BELOW_COUNT` naming the count; the recount predicate uses the explicit `OR: [{createdSource: null}, {not: SPEAKER_COMPANION}]` because Prisma `not` excludes nulls). **Public UX:** the public event API exposes ONLY an `eventFull` flag (raw counters stripped); both register pages show a branded "Registration Full" state; **HYBRID events stay open** with an amber "in-person full — virtual available" banner (virtual is uncapped). Clone copies the cap, never the counter. **Post-ship adversarial review (owner: ship first, review after): 1 HIGH + 1 MED, both fixed same day** — HIGH-1: `bulk_update_registration_status` is ORG-scoped (ids may span sibling events) but applied all event-seat deltas to `ctx.eventId`, silently corrupting two events' counters; deltas now group per each row's OWN `eventId`. MED-1: a CSV row imported as `registrationStatus=CANCELLED` claimed both counters while holding no seat — the claim block now skips cancelled rows (**also closes the pre-existing deferred M6** soldCount inflation). LOWs 1–4 (oversell-report race = log-accuracy only; cap-tx-before-main-update matches the accepted split-PUT posture; one new `tenantTransaction` migration site; a theoretical predicate footnote) in ROADMAP §"Seat capacity follow-ups". **Tests:** +28 unit + **10 REAL-Postgres integration tests** ([tests/crm-db/seat-capacity.db.test.ts](tests/crm-db/seat-capacity.db.test.ts) — the shared real-DB harness): raw-SQL boundary (admits at max−1, blocks at max), 10-concurrent-claims-vs-cap-5 race admits exactly 5, guarded-release floor, tx-rollback conservation. Suite 3753 + 15 crm-db; tsc/eslint/build green. Enforcement is inert until an organizer sets a cap.

Now: **(1) API** — ticket-type PUT/POST accept `quantity` (int ≥ 1); PUT rejects a limit below `soldCount` (400 + warn log, mirroring the tier guard); the tier PATCH already accepted it. **(2) Registration Types page** ([tickets/page.tsx](src/app/%28dashboard%29/events/%5BeventId%5D/tickets/page.tsx)) — "Seat Limit" input on BOTH the type and tier dialogs (**empty = unlimited** → sends the sentinel; no migration, no nullable-quantity change); type cards + tier rows render `sold/limit seats` + a red sold-out state; dialogs show "N already sold" when editing. **(3) Semantics (owner decision: independent counters, NO dual-count):** a **tier's** limit caps public self-registrations on that tier (the Early Bird/Standard/Onsite allocation ask); the **type-level** limit caps admin/desk/import adds + public sign-ups on tier-less types — a public tier sale never touches the type counter (pre-existing accounting, deliberately kept; helper text in both dialogs explains it). **(4) Public register page** — "N seats left" per option (amber ≤ 10), rendered only when a real limit exists AND the event's **Show Remaining Tickets** toggle is explicitly ON: the previously-dormant toggle is now wired end-to-end (public event API exposes `showRemainingTickets`, strict `=== true` opt-in) and its default flipped to **OFF**; the existing "Sold out" state was already live. Cancel releases the same counter the seat was claimed on and reactivation re-claims through the atomic guard (the June-29 tier-aware seat model). **Deliberately untouched (owner decisions):** the dormant Settings "Maximum Attendees"/"Enable Waitlist" controls (an event-level total cap is a future own pass — needs an `Event.seatCount` counter + ~7 guard sites, see ROADMAP §"Seat capacity follow-ups"), and the held `reconcile-soldcounts.ts --write` (no past events need limits; counters correct going forward). +7 route tests (suite 3739); tsc/eslint/vitest/build green.

- **Multi-tenancy Phase 2 — Contacts pilot sweep (July 23, 2026, commits C1–C5)** — The first per-domain isolation pass, ratifying the recipe every later domain repeats (as-executed record: docs/MULTI_TENANCY.md §13). All behavior-preserving on master (`RLS_SET_LOCAL` stays OFF). **(C1)** the five by-id Contact mutations became compound-where `{ id, organizationId }` (org binding atomic with the write — defence #1, RLS-independent) and the domain's 2 `$transaction` sites moved to `tenantTransaction` (bulk-tags array-form → sequential in-tx loop with `{ timeout: 30s, maxWait: 10s }` + a `contactIds` max(1000) cap; review: SAFE, 0 blocker/high/med). **(C2)** every `/api/contacts/*` handler + the 3 contact agent executors wrap their body in `runWithTenant(ctx.organizationId, …)` after guards — explicit per-handler (greppable invariant: resolves org context ⇒ wraps), no HOF/middleware; TS-narrowing gotcha: capture `session.user.organizationId` as a const before the closure. **(C3)** new **`prisma/rls/`** shared per-domain policy dir — [contact.sql](prisma/rls/contact.sql) is the FLAT policy (`USING/WITH CHECK ("organizationId" = current_setting('app.current_org', true))`, **ratifying flat-vs-join = FLAT**, IMPACT §7), applied by BOTH the tenancy harness (global-setup now reads `tests/tenancy/policies/*` then `prisma/rls/*`) and the future platform bootstrap — **never a prisma migration** (FORCE in the chain = master outage; ENABLE-only excluded by policy so master's DB stays RLS-object-free and policies stay single-sourced; NO FORCE in shared files — enforcement is the non-owner app role, the harness two-role split being the platform's reference architecture). Plus: explicit `FOR ALL TO PUBLIC` in the template policy, the org-re-homing UPDATE test (the one write compound-where can't catch — WITH CHECK blocks it), cross-tenant DELETE miss test, the tripwire mechanism test (assert resolves as app_user / refuses as owner), existsSync contract error on the SQL dirs, owner-URL guard in the bypass test — harness 22 → 25.) **(C5)** docs + this entry. Deferred fast-follows: **MediaFile policy ✅ shipped July 24 (`a444f035`)**; CrmContact policy (~1 file + seed + tests; blocked on CRM landing on prod) + the runWithTenant lint gate.

- **Fresh-DB migration-replay CI job + chain repair (July 22, 2026)** — New non-gating **`migration-replay`** CI job in deploy.yml (postgres:16-alpine service container on the GitHub VM, zero box resources): replays the ENTIRE `prisma/migrations` chain against an EMPTY database via `prisma migrate deploy`, then asserts the result matches `schema.prisma` exactly via `prisma migrate diff --exit-code`. **Why:** prod only ever migrates incrementally, so a chain broken from scratch stays invisible until the first fresh database needs it — which is exactly how the two-silo **platform instance** (docs/MULTI_TENANCY.md §0) gets born. **The first local run found the chain WAS broken:** (a) `20260225000000_add_contact_specialty` altered `Contact` before any migration creates it (table was `db push`-ed pre-discipline; created later WITH the column by `20260303000000`) — repaired with `ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS`; (b) `20260518120000_add_registration_serial_counter`'s backfill read `Registration."serialId"`, a column **no migration ever created** — backfill now gated on column existence; (c) **~250 lines of db-push drift** the chain never captured (PromoCode family + `DiscountType`, `DeviceToken`, `EventStats`, `Registration.serialId/originalPrice/discountAmount/promoCodeId`, `Event.code/emailFrom*`, Invoice discount columns, the InvoiceCounter org/year→event reshape, `UserRole.MEMBER`, the Title enum cleanup, FK/index/default diffs) — captured in **`20260722140000_sync_chain_to_prod_schema`**, whose ENTIRE body is gated on ONE sentinel (`to_regclass('public."PromoCode"')` non-null → RETURN): on prod (sentinel verified present via SSM) it is a single catalog lookup and touches nothing (proven by applying it to a `db push`-shaped seeded DB — schema dump byte-identical, data intact); on a chain-built fresh DB the full drift applies (incl. a partial→full unique-index swap on `CertificateIssueRunItem` — the chain's partial indexes are un-representable in Prisma; full composite uniques are functionally identical since Postgres treats NULLs as distinct). One sentinel beats 58 per-statement guards — there is no partially-drifted third shape. Acceptance: full 125-migration replay from empty → **"No difference detected"** vs schema.prisma. **Also corrected a false safety claim** in `scripts/check-migration-safety.sh`: `migrate deploy` skips applied migrations BY NAME and never re-verifies checksums (only `migrate dev` does — verified empirically), so the repair edits cannot affect prod's incremental path; editing applied migrations remains forbidden EXCEPT for provably behavior-invisible fresh-replay repairs, now pinned by this CI job. Ack entry in `prisma/destructive-migrations-ack.txt`. Same promotion rule as the tenancy job: gate after ≥5 consecutive green runs.

- **Multi-tenancy Phase 0 — "the spine" BUILT (July 22, 2026, owner-approved plan; 11 gated commits `2473d8ab`…`548e9b54` + docs)** — First build step of the **two-silo decision** (docs/MULTI_TENANCY.md §0: master stays MMG-only; a future platform instance with a fresh DB hosts all external tenants; ONE repo/image, two deploy targets). Everything is **behavior-preserving on master**: with zero `TenantDomain` rows and no `DEFAULT_ORG_ID`/`TENANCY_ENFORCE_HOST`/`RLS_SET_LOCAL` env (master's state), every new code path resolves to the byte-identical legacy behavior — pinned by equivalence tests. **(1) `TenantDomain`** host→org table (additive+idempotent migration `20260722080000`) + idempotent `scripts/add-tenant-domain.ts` (upsert by domain, org by id-or-slug, `--list`; deliberately an ops script, NOT a data migration). **(2) Host→org resolver** ([src/lib/tenant/resolver.ts](src/lib/tenant/resolver.ts)) — VERIFIED rows only (unverified never routes), three-stage unknown-host safety ramp (DEFAULT_ORG_ID → unscoped-legacy → 404-semantics under enforce), never-throws (DB error → ramp + `tenant:resolve-failed`), bounded 500-entry negative-caching micro-cache (Host is attacker-controlled). **In a LIBRARY, not middleware** (deviation from §3.1 as-planned, recorded there): `proxy.ts` untouched; the where-builder calls it internally so resolver + slug cut land atomically. **(3) The slug cut** — `Event.slug` is only `@@unique([organizationId, slug])`, so ALL ~26 public event-by-slug lookup sites (the #1 latent cross-tenant leak) now build their where via **`publicEventWhere`** ([src/lib/public-event.ts](src/lib/public-event.ts), a where-FRAGMENT builder so each route keeps its own select; swept in 4 chunks: Shape-A OR-fallback routes, Shape-B status-gated routes, Shape-C relation filters + `public-event-metadata.ts` (host through the React `cache()` keys) + the lobby-status cache key gaining an org prefix, and the token routes (rsvp/reimbursement/agreements/survey/complete-registration) gaining a post-load `eventMatchesRequestTenant` defense-in-depth assert). Independent adversarial review: **SAFE TO SHIP, 0 blocker/high**; LOW riders applied (lobby cache-key typeof guard). check-email's cross-tenant email-existence disclosure closes once hosts resolve. **(4) ALS tenant context + flag-gated SET LOCAL extension** ([src/lib/tenant-context.ts](src/lib/tenant-context.ts) + [src/lib/db.ts](src/lib/db.ts)) — `RLS_SET_LOCAL=1` wraps each model op in the official Prisma batch-`set_config('app.current_org', …, TRUE)` pattern (pooler-safe: GUC + query share one transaction/backend); OFF on master (pure passthrough); `db` export cast back to `PrismaClient` (extension is behavior-only; the extended type broke ~50 `Prisma.TransactionClient` params — pre-agreed fallback); **`tenantTransaction()`** is the sanctioned interactive-tx wrapper and migrating the ~88 existing `$transaction` sites onto it is the RECORDED Phase-2 precondition before the flag ever enables; dead `src/lib/org-context.ts` deleted. **(5) The tenant-isolation harness** ([tests/tenancy/](tests/tenancy/), own vitest project `npm run test:tenancy`) — REAL postgres:16 + edoburu/pgbouncer in TRANSACTION mode (`docker compose --profile tenancy up -d`, ports 55432/56432), **two-role split** (owner provisions via `TENANCY_DIRECT_URL` — owners bypass RLS; tests run as non-owner `app_user` through the pooler via `TENANCY_DATABASE_URL`), two seeded tenants SHARING an event slug, pilot Event RLS as **harness-only SQL** (not a prod migration), 13 assertions incl. deliberately-unscoped-query-blocked, fail-closed-no-store, 50-way pooler-interleave no-leak, `tenantTransaction` WITH-CHECK write-block — **13/13 green locally**. **The harness immediately caught a real bug**: PrismaPromises are lazy, so `runWithTenant(org, () => db.x.find())` exited the ALS scope before execution → extension saw no store → fail-closed empty results; `runWithTenant`/`enterTenantTx` now force execution in-scope (lazy-thenable regression test). **(6) CI**: non-gating `tenancy` job (postgres+pgbouncer service containers; promote to gating after ≥5 green runs) + the GATING **`scripts/check-tenant-scoping.sh`** grep-gate (public `db.event.find*` must use the helper; hand-rolled `event:{…slug…}` relation filters flagged; empty allow-list; verified catching both injected violation shapes). +36 unit tests (suite → 3666) + 13 harness tests. **Not yet done:** master ops step (seed `events.meetingmindsgroup.com` row + `DEFAULT_ORG_ID` on the box — until then the resolver warn-logs `tenant:host-unresolved-unscoped` ~1/min/container, accepted), CI-job promotion, Phase-1 decisions (user-identity model, Stripe Connect). Build order + status in docs/MULTI_TENANCY.md §0/§3.

- **Incremental-sync date filters on the speakers + registrations lists — REST + MCP (July 21, 2026, integrator request, commit `70f8cded`, pkg 0.4.23→0.4.24)** — The API-key list endpoints integrations pull from (the n8n→Webflow people sync had to full-pull the roster every run) are now filterable by **created/updated date**: four optional params — `createdAfter` / `createdBefore` / `updatedAfter` / `updatedBefore` (ISO 8601, bounds **inclusive**; `updatedAfter` is the incremental-sync checkpoint) — on REST `GET /api/events/[eventId]/speakers` (previously status-only) + `GET .../registrations` (alongside status/paymentStatus/ticketTypeId/tags) AND MCP `list_speakers` / `list_registrations` (executors + tool defs + the register-mcp-tools Zod mirrors — **MCP clients reconnect**; pkg bumped + lockfile). ONE shared parser, [src/lib/date-range-filter.ts](src/lib/date-range-filter.ts) `parseDateRangeFilters()` (no cross-caller duplication): an unparsable value is an **error** (REST 400 + warn log, MCP tool error, both `code: "INVALID_DATE_FILTER"`), never a silently-dropped filter — the bad-filter-widens class the July 13 bulk-email `INVALID_FILTER` fix closed. **Internal surfaces unaffected by construction**: the dashboard hooks hit the same GETs but never send the params, and with no params the parser returns an empty `where` that spreads to a no-op (pinned by test); the 400 path is unreachable without opting in. Both responses already carry `createdAt`/`updatedAt` per row for checkpointing (no select changes needed). The public OpenAPI spec (`/api-docs`) documents the four params on both endpoints. +15 tests (10 parser: inclusive gte/lte mapping, single-bound checkpoint shape, absent/empty=inactive, per-param error cases, all-or-nothing, date-only values; 5 MCP wiring: where-shape threading, INVALID_DATE_FILTER short-circuits before any query, no-params no-op) — suite 3566 → 3581. tsc/eslint/vitest/build green. Docs: MCP_REFERENCE.md (new dated section + table rows) + the OpenAPI spec. **Follow-up candidates (not built):** `?tags=` + `?sessionRole=` on the speakers GET (would let the Webflow committee pull filter server-side + fix the tag case-sensitivity gotcha at the same time), and the `?segment=internal` union filter from docs/COMMITTEE_MEMBERS.md.

- **Cross-caller duplication audit — 3 drifted clusters consolidated + verified backlog (July 21, 2026, commits `814224aa`/`6b66649a`/`858a50cd` + review-fix follow-up)** — A repo-wide duplication audit surfaced 11 cross-caller findings; each was **verified against source by independent agents BEFORE any fix** (2 of 11 characterizations were wrong, and verification found 2 real bugs the audit missed). The three ALREADY-DRIFTED clusters shipped as gated commits. **(1) `814224aa` — seat+promo accounting consolidated** ([registration-seat-db.ts](src/lib/registration-seat-db.ts) gains `releasePromoUsage` (guarded, relative clamp — never negative), `claimPromoUsage`, `claimSeats` (guarded all-or-nothing bulk claim; `claimSeat` delegates), `claimSeatsOverselling` (the bulk-reactivation allow-and-log policy)); the MCP `bulk_update_registration_status` executor, the REST bulk-type route, and the REST delete route now route through them — fixing the **unguarded `promoCode.update({ decrement })`** on the MCP-bulk + delete paths (usedCount could go negative → a maxUses-capped code admitted extra redemptions) and adding the **H6 promo re-claim on bulk reactivation** (bulk cancel → reactivate → cancel used to double-release). The audit's "three oversell rules" framing was verified WRONG — bulk-type already hard-blocked 409; real drift was two-way. **(2) `6b66649a` — `promo-code-service.createPromoCode`** — REST POST + MCP `create_promo_code` were two drifting inline creates: **MCP wrote NO audit log**, REST never event-validated `ticketTypeIds` (silently linked foreign ticket types), MCP never enforced FIXED_AMOUNT-requires-currency. One service path now owns all of it (6 error codes incl. the P2002 race → DUPLICATE_CODE); REST status codes unchanged, MCP shape preserved. **(3) `858a50cd` — `abstract-service.assignReviewer/unassignReviewer`** — the twice-drifted (H6/H8) ~130-line REST+MCP reviewer-assignment pair is ONE implementation (org-scoped lookups, NOT_REVIEWABLE gate, upsert role/COI semantics, source-tagged audits now with before-values on both surfaces, create-only notification); response bodies byte-compatible, all 15 pre-existing route/COI tests pass unchanged. **Post-ship adversarial review of the batches: 0 BLOCKER / 0 HIGH / 3 MED / 5 LOW** — fixed in-band: M1 (the promo clamp fallback became a RELATIVE guarded decrement — an absolute `set 0` could have erased a concurrent redemption committed between the two statements), M2 (REST reviewers 500 bodies restored to the stable `ASSIGN/UNASSIGN_REVIEWER_FAILED` contract instead of leaking raw error text; service UNKNOWN messages are static), L2 (promo audit-failure log restored warn→error per the never-downgrade-alerts rule). Deferred (ROADMAP §"Cross-caller duplication audit"): findings 4–7 (setSessionSpeakers consolidation, MCP invoice-status through `cancelInvoice` + REST invoice audit gap, a canonical `rateLimited()` 429 helper — exactly 4 of 105 sites miss `Retry-After`, folding MCP single add/remove-speaker into session-service), M3 (bulk-status promo-re-claim TOCTOU), L4 (releaseExistingRedemption still hand-rolled), and the frontend cluster A4 (detail-sheet edits missing state/zip only — the audit's tags/photo/website claims were wrong) / A6 (speaker-status colour map ×5 with agenda drift → needs `speaker-enums.ts`) / A8 (dialog-vs-page free/paid tier-resolution divergence). Full report: [docs/CODE_REVIEW_DUPLICATION_JULY21.html](docs/CODE_REVIEW_DUPLICATION_JULY21.html). +34 tests across the batches (suite 3517 → 3548 + review-fix pins); tsc/eslint/vitest/build green per batch. **Stale-doc note fixed in passing:** the "MCP `update_invoice_status` REFUNDED is DB-only" claim in this file's tool list is outdated — the June 10 M6 fix narrowed the tool to CANCELLED/OVERDUE. **Tranche 2 — findings 4–7 shipped same day (owner go-ahead):** `56dcad12` **session roster ops → session-service** — `setSessionSpeakersTx` is the ONE atomic swap + L1 topic-cleanup applier (shared by `updateSession` step 2 + the new `replaceSessionRoster`), and `addSessionSpeaker`/`removeSessionSpeaker`/`replaceSessionRoster` own the H1 break-item truth table + source-tagged audits, with the three MCP roster executors reduced to thin wrappers (byte-compatible shapes; 3 production `as never` casts removed); `14540e81` **invoice status transitions** — shared `transitionInvoiceStatus` (idempotency guard + optional source-tagged audit) behind `cancelInvoice(id, ctx?)` + the new `markInvoiceOverdue`; **REST invoice status changes are audited for the first time** and MCP delegates instead of bare-updating; `9e9f2ed0` **canonical `rateLimited()` 429 helper** in [src/lib/api-errors.ts](src/lib/api-errors.ts) (RFC-9110 `Retry-After` + `code: "RATE_LIMITED"` + `retryAfterSeconds`, always logs) applied to all 7 call sites in the 4 files that omitted the header (agent execute, public complete-registration, both agreement routes); the ~100 compliant sites migrate opportunistically — **new code must use the helper**. Post-ship review of tranche 2: 0 BLOCKER / 0 HIGH / 2 MED / 7 LOW — **its M1 ("mcp-remote audit FK fails") was REFUTED by hand-verification** (migration `20260418000000_seed_mcp_system_user` seeds the User row; the tranche-1 reviewer had it right — when two reviews contradict, read the migration); M2 (no source-state gate on invoice transitions — a PAID invoice can still be marked OVERDUE/CANCELLED, pre-existing) is an **owner decision** in ROADMAP; L2/L3/L5 riders fixed in-band. +18 more tests (suite → 3566). - **Workshop + Symposium session types (July 23, 2026, organizer request, pkg 0.4.24→0.4.25)** — Two new **program** SessionType values, the opposite of break items: full sessions (speakers/topics/track/Zoom all allowed, same service rules as SESSION) that render **inside their assigned track's column** on the dashboard grid — never as full-width bands — and count in every session stat. The load-bearing change: `isBreakSessionType` was "anything ≠ SESSION", which would have silently made the new types break items; [session-enums.ts](src/lib/session-enums.ts) now carries an explicit **`SESSION_TYPE_KIND` classification Record** (exhaustive over the Prisma enum — a future value fails the BUILD until classified program-vs-break) + **`BREAK_SESSION_TYPES`** for Prisma filters, and every count site that filtered `type: "SESSION"` exactly (cached `EventStats.sessionCount`, `get_event_dashboard`, `get_event_stats`, `list_live_sessions_now`) flipped to `type: { notIn: BREAK_SESSION_TYPES }` so workshops/symposia count. Wired through: additive+idempotent enum migration `20260723120000`, dashboard type picker (full program form — track/roles/topics/Zoom sections show), public agenda + public session page (small "Workshop"/"Symposium" chip; normal detail pages, NOT 404'd like breaks), agenda CSV import aliases, MCP `create_session`/`update_session` Zod mirrors + descriptions (**MCP clients reconnect**; pkg bumped), and the MCP topic/roster gates re-keyed from `type !== "SESSION"` to `isBreakSessionType`. Verified visually on the test DB (dashboard grid: workshop card in its own track column beside a spanning coffee band; public agenda chips). +2 tests (suite 3669). **Related fix, same day (`a7824fa4`):** break items on the dashboard multi-track grid now render as full-width `BreakBand` overlays spanning all columns instead of minting a phantom "No Track" column (the organizer-reported "adding a coffee break created a new track").
- **Agenda break items — Registration / Coffee Break / Lunch / Networking as first-class time blocks (July 21, 2026, organizer request, commit `fcd86151`, pkg 0.4.22→0.4.23)** — The agenda now distinguishes real program sessions from **break items**: plain time blocks with no speakers, topics, abstract, track, or Zoom. New `SessionType` enum + `EventSession.type` (default SESSION; additive+idempotent migration `20260721140000_add_session_type`). **Invariant lives in ONE place** — [session-service.ts](src/services/session-service.ts) `validate()` checks the RESULTING state (`BREAK_ITEM_HAS_PROGRAM`, 400): converting a session requires the payload to explicitly clear its roster (the dashboard form does this by submitting empty lists — we never auto-delete on the caller's behalf); an attached **Zoom meeting blocks conversion** (the edit dialog hides the Zoom section for break items, so conversion would strand a live billable meeting), and the **webinar anchor session can never be converted** (409 `WEBINAR_ANCHOR_SESSION`, mirroring the DELETE guard). The per-roster MCP executors (`add_speaker_to_session` / `add_topic_to_session` / `replace_session_speakers`) bypass the service and therefore enforce the gate themselves (adversarial-review H1). Shared display constants + the `isBreakSessionType()` hinge live in [session-enums.ts](src/lib/session-enums.ts) — **fails OPEN** on absent/unknown type (a pre-migration cached row can never be hidden; pinned by tests both ways after the suite caught the original fail-closed 404 guard). Wired through every surface: REST POST/PUT Zod (`z.nativeEnum(SessionType)`), MCP `create_session`/`update_session` `type` param (**MCP clients reconnect**; pkg bumped), the dashboard agenda (Type picker as the first form field — break types hide track/capacity/roles/topics/Zoom sections; muted dashed cards with per-type icons; the save toast now surfaces the server's actual error instead of a generic failure), the public agenda (slim muted bands with coffee/lunch icons), and the public session detail route (404 for break items). **Counts:** break items are excluded from the agenda "Sessions"/"Scheduled" tiles, `list_live_sessions_now`, `get_event_dashboard`/`get_event_stats`, and the cached `EventStats.sessionCount`. Adversarial review: 0 BLOCKER / 1 HIGH / 4 MED / 6 LOW — H1+M2+M3+M4+L1+L2 shipped in-band; deferred (ROADMAP §"Agenda break items review"): M1 check-then-act race on the invariant (narrow, self-healing), L3 HTTP-MCP can't convert topic-bearing sessions (extends the known `update_session`-omits-topics gap), L4 registration-page preview renders breaks plainly, and ~~the multi-track known limitation (a break renders in the "No Track" column, not spanning all tracks)~~ — **✅ fixed July 23, 2026**: breaks are excluded from the track-column grouping and render as full-width `BreakBand` bands spanning all columns (below session cards in z-order, so overlapping sessions stay visible/clickable; breaks also bypass the track filter). **Same-day follow-up (owner ask):** the agenda **CSV import** gained an optional `type` column (aliases: "Coffee Break"→BREAK, "Lunch Break"→LUNCH; unknown value = a ROW error, never a silent SESSION default; break rows ignore track/capacity — documented in the dialog — while speakers on a break row surface the service's rejection as a row error), and the **in-app AI Agent** can create break items via the shared `create_session` tool (an opening ceremony is a normal SESSION with speakers). +30 tests total (suite 3505); user-guide §3 "Break items" sub-section added (picked up by the help chatbot). tsc/eslint/vitest/build green. **Multi-day-programme review round (same day, owner ask):** verified the CSV import handles a 3-day programme structurally, and fixed the two things that would have bitten it — **(a) timezone-naive CSV datetimes were parsed in the SERVER's timezone** (UTC in prod), silently shifting an Excel-authored Dubai "09:00" to 1 PM; they are now read as **event wall-clock** via `wallTimeInTzToDate` (explicit `Z`/`±HH:MM` offsets still honored — matches the dashboard form's semantics); **(b) re-importing a corrected file duplicated the whole agenda** — rows matching an existing (name, startTime) are now **skipped** and reported (`skipped` count; in-file duplicate rows too). Also killed the residual agenda-domain duplication: ONE `HTTP_STATUS_FOR_SESSION_ERROR` map ([src/lib/session-http.ts](src/lib/session-http.ts), exhaustive over the service's error union — both routes used to carry hand-synced copies), the `[sessionId]` route + list GET now use the service's exported `SESSION_SELECT` (the list GET additionally gained `updatedAt`, additive), and every status/role/type literal list (route Zod, MCP whitelists, CSV whitelist) is now **derived from the Prisma enums** so a new enum value fails the build instead of drifting. +12 tests (suite 3517).

- **Speaker / Faculty reimbursement form — web replacement for the paper wire-transfer PDF (July 20, 2026, owner request)** — Speakers claim their speaker fee / flights / hotel / ground transport online instead of the emailed DOCX ("MMG Speaker Reimbursement Form"). **Owner decisions locked:** v1 is **submission-only** (PENDING → SUBMITTED; approval/payment tracking stays outside the system), dashboard visibility is **SUPER_ADMIN/ADMIN/ORGANIZER only**, currencies are **USD/AED/SAR** (as on the paper form). **Model** (additive+idempotent migration `20260720120500_add_speaker_reimbursement` — **applies on next deploy via deploy.sh, not yet on prod**): `SpeakerReimbursement` (one per speaker per event — `speakerId @unique`; unguessable plaintext token like RsvpInvite; Section B snapshot fields + `claimLines` JSON + `bankDetails` JSON + typed-name signature/`submittedAt`/`submittedIp`) + `SpeakerReimbursementDocument` (kind PASSPORT/FLIGHT_RECEIPT/HOTEL_INVOICE/TRANSPORT_RECEIPT/OTHER). **Flow:** organizer console at [/events/[eventId]/reimbursements](src/app/%28dashboard%29/events/%5BeventId%5D/reimbursements/page.tsx) (Setup-hub card, like Dinner RSVP) — add speakers (mints tokens), email personalized links via the new editable **`speaker-reimbursement-invitation`** template (single/all/pending; EmailLog-based 10-min batch retry-safety; logged against the SPEAKER entity so it shows on the speaker's Email History), copy link, review submissions (claim + bank + docs), CSV export for finance (audited PII extraction), **"Reopen for edits"** (conditional SUBMITTED→PENDING claim, audited) and delete. Speaker fills [/e/[slug]/reimbursement/[token]](src/app/e/%5Bslug%5D/reimbursement/%5Btoken%5D/page.tsx) — sections A–F mirroring the paper form, prefilled from the Speaker record, per-currency live totals (never summed across currencies), uploads (PDF/JPG/PNG magic-byte validated, 10MB, max 15), declaration + typed-name e-signature; submit is a **conditional claim on PENDING** (double-submit race commits once), audited with IP (agreement-acceptance shape), fires `notifyEventAdmins` + an automated **`speaker-reimbursement-received`** confirmation email (both failure-isolated). **The paper form's receipt rule is server-enforced**: passport copy always + the matching receipt per claimed expense (`requiredDocumentKinds` in [src/lib/reimbursement/constants.ts](src/lib/reimbursement/constants.ts)); speaker fee needs no receipt. **PII/security:** passport + bank details are wire-transfer data — every dashboard route (reads included) is `denyReviewer(session)`-gated (its restricted set is exactly the excluded population; `canManageReimbursements()` is the named UI predicate, fails closed); uploaded files live under `public/uploads/reimbursements/` (persistent volume + hourly DR sync) but the public `/uploads` catch-all **BLOCKS that prefix** — files stream only via the authed `GET .../reimbursements/[id]/documents/[documentId]` (event-bound + traversal-guarded + re-rooted). Public routes rate-limited per IP + per token; every rejection logs. Client-safe lib split ([constants.ts](src/lib/reimbursement/constants.ts) zod+pure helpers / [server.ts](src/lib/reimbursement/server.ts) token+loader) so the form page never bundles Node crypto. +33 tests ([reimbursement.test.ts](__tests__/lib/reimbursement.test.ts) totals/receipt-rule/predicate/schema + [reimbursement-public-routes.test.ts](__tests__/api/reimbursement-public-routes.test.ts) conditional-claim/lock/missing-docs/uploads-block); suite 3457. tsc/eslint/vitest/build green (e2e: 11 pre-existing failures on clean HEAD, unrelated — verified by stash-rerun). **Follow-up round (same day, owner requests):** send dialog gained **Preview** (renders the real per-event template + typed subject/message via the shared `/email-preview` route, template auto-selected — bulk-email-dialog parity) and an **Edit the template** deep link into the template editor (the templates list GET auto-seeds system defaults as editable rows, so the id always exists); the public form's banner is **width-constrained (`max-w-[1120px]`)** like the other public pages instead of full-bleed; **reimbursement activity now shows on the speaker profile's Activity timeline** (activity-feed.ts resolves the speaker's reimbursement row and folds its `SPEAKER_REIMBURSEMENT` audits in, remapped to `REIMBURSEMENT_SUBMITTED`/`REIMBURSEMENT_REOPENED` etc. so the card reads "Reimbursement form submitted", Banknote icon; the invitation email was already on the timeline via its SPEAKER EmailLog row); and a **Reimbursement card on the speaker profile** ([speaker-reimbursement-card.tsx](src/components/speakers/speaker-reimbursement-card.tsx), self-hides outside the staff boundary) — status + totals, Create & email link, resend, copy link, open console; backed by a `?speakerId=` filter on the list GET. **Docs:** [docs/SPEAKER_REIMBURSEMENT.md](docs/SPEAKER_REIMBURSEMENT.md) (model, boundary, routes, receipt rule) + user-guide "Speaker Reimbursements" section (console + speaker-profile send steps, FAQ — picked up by the help chatbot). **Deferred:** approval/paid tracking (schema leaves room for enum growth), a `speaker-reimbursement` emailType in the BULK-email pipeline (owner: "no need" — the dedicated send route is the one sender), MCP tools.

- **CRM in-app notification service — own bell, own table, separate from event notifications (July 17, 2026, owner request)** — The CRM module now has its own notification service, **deliberately NOT merged with the core `src/lib/notifications.ts`** (owner decision: the event platform's bell never carries pipeline traffic, and core never reads Crm* tables — the module boundary holds). **Model:** new `CrmNotification` (org + recipient `userId` Cascade, string `type`, title/message/link, `isRead`; additive+idempotent migration `20260717120000_add_crm_notification` — **not on prod**, like the rest of the CRM module). **One writer** ([src/crm/lib/crm-notifications.ts](src/crm/lib/crm-notifications.ts) `notifyCrmUser()`, the `recordCrmActivity` one-writer rule): the two cross-cutting rules live in the writer, not at call sites — a user is **never notified about their own action** (actor/recipient compare) and it **never throws** (the mutation it describes already committed; failures log `crm-notification:write-failed` and are swallowed). **Triggers (owner-picked, all four):** deal assigned to you (createDeal + updateDeal re-assign, new owner only, unchanged-ownerId re-sends don't re-nag), your deal stage-moved/**won**/**lost** (moveDealStage announces the OUTCOME when the drag lands in a mapped terminal column; closeDeal too), task assigned to you (create + re-assign), and the reminders worker's **task-due** in-app nudge — minted right after the `remindedAt` conditional claim so it rides the same idempotency as the reminder email and reaches mailbox-less temp accounts. **In-app only** (owner decision: no email — the reminders worker already emails; no push). Messages carry **no deal money**, so FINANCIAL_KEYS redaction never arises for the feed. **API:** `GET/PATCH /api/crm/notifications` (feed + unread count / mark-read `{ids}` or `{all:true}`) — `requireCrmRead`/`requireCrmWrite` gated (passes the source-level gate-drift test), reads+writes scoped to the caller's own `userId`+org in the `where` (no IDOR by construction), API-key callers get 400 `NO_USER_CONTEXT` (notifications are per-user). **UI:** [CrmNotificationBell](src/crm/components/crm-notification-bell.tsx) in the CRM shell header ([crm/layout.tsx](src/app/%28dashboard%29/crm/layout.tsx)) — unread badge, per-type icons, click → mark read + navigate, mark-all-read; `useCrmNotifications` polls 30s ([use-crm-api.ts](src/crm/hooks/use-crm-api.ts)). +21 tests (writer invariants incl. never-throws, effect-level trigger tests asserting the `db.crmNotification.create` payload per the H4 lesson, worker claim-gated nudge) + `crmNotification` mocks added to 4 existing CRM suites; suite 3307 → 3338. Docs: [src/crm/README.md](src/crm/README.md) §3.8 + CRM_STATUS.html. tsc/eslint/vitest/build green.

- **Email previews render ACTUAL data + 8px paragraph rhythm + session time windows (July 17, 2026, owner requests)** — Three related email rounds, shipped in phases (`33c489e1`, `b2f5b1f6`, `40646488`, `edfae54e`, `87ecfe27`). **(1) Paragraph rhythm 16px → 8px.** The Tiptap editor's block spacing (`[&>*]:mb-4` → `mb-2` in [tiptap-editor.tsx](src/components/ui/tiptap-editor.tsx)), the branding wrapper's juice-inlined `p { margin: 0 0 8px 0; }` rule ([email.ts](src/lib/email.ts)), and the CRM cover-email greeting's hardcoded margin all halved **in lockstep** so editor and sent email keep WYSIWYG parity (the July-16 honesty model preserved — the rule exists because email clients otherwise apply their own ~1em defaults). NOTE: the public pages rendering editor-authored HTML (welcome/terms, `[&>*]:mb-4` on `/e/[slug]/*`) were deliberately left at 16px — sweep them if one rhythm everywhere is wanted. **(2) presentationDetails now carries session time windows + durations.** `buildPresentationBlocks` ([speaker-agreement.ts](src/lib/speaker-agreement.ts)) renders one "Date & Time" line **per session** — start–end clock in the event TZ + duration, e.g. "Monday, March 15, 2026, 9:00 AM – 10:30 AM GMT+4 (1h 30m)" (new `formatSessionWindow`/`formatSessionDuration`; topic-session fallback deduped; `endTime` added to the topic select). The **`{sessionDateTime}` docx merge token stays format-stable** (start time only — it lands in the quasi-legal agreement document; pinned by test). **(3) Preview honesty — every token, all three failure classes closed.** Root causes: `renderTemplate` leaves unknown keys as literal `{{token}}`, and the sample-vars set was missing ~21 tokens (so previewing any webinar template, payment-confirmation, presenter-agreement, reviewer notify, or a speaker template showed raw tokens), while `{{organizerSignature}}` showed a canned sample. Now: **(a)** [getSamplePreviewVariables](src/lib/email.ts) covers every token (webinar joinUrl/passcodeBlock/recordingBlock/webinarDate/webinarTime/panelist+session fields, receiptBlock/paymentReference, presenter/reviewer/cert tokens, entryBarcode placeholder box — samples in the real senders' EXACT markup); **(b)** both preview routes ([email-preview](src/app/api/events/%5BeventId%5D/email-preview/route.ts) + the [template test-send](src/app/api/events/%5BeventId%5D/email-templates/%5BtemplateId%5D/route.ts)) fetch the caller's **real `User.emailSignature`** (empty when they have none — an honest preview never promises a signature the send won't render) and greet `{{speakerName}}`/`{{presenterName}}`/`{{recipientName}}` with the signed-in user; **(c)** new **[src/lib/email-preview-data.ts](src/lib/email-preview-data.ts)** `buildRealPreviewOverrides(eventId)` — the async real-data layer both routes run in parallel: first session (name, start in event TZ, the **gated-session joinUrl**, webinarDate/Time), the **real Zoom passcode** + recording state (absent when no Zoom attached, so samples stand), latest abstract titles + real count, a representative session-linked speaker's REAL presentationDetails block, real login/review links; failure-isolated (enrichment error → warn log + samples render, a preview can never 500 from it). **Deliberately still representative** (documented in the module header): per-recipient minted links (survey/rsvp/agreement — minting real tokens in a preview would rotate live credentials), payment artifacts, un-issued cert serials, entryBarcode (cid-attached PNG), per-abstract decision fields. **(d) Drift guard** ([email-preview-vars.test.ts](__tests__/lib/email-preview-vars.test.ts)): every `{{token}}` in every default template AND every advertised `TEMPLATE_VARIABLES` key must have a preview value — a future template with an unsampled token fails the suite, not an organizer's Preview click. **(4) New `{{moderatorDetails}}`/`{{moderatorDetailsText}}` variable (owner request, same day).** For each session the recipient **MODERATES** (`SessionSpeaker.role === MODERATOR`): session name + location + time window, then the full **topic run-sheet** — Time | Topic | Speaker(s) | Duration table, with each topic's start–end **computed by stacking topic durations from the session start** (SessionTopic stores no start time; an un-timed topic shows "—" and does not advance the clock). Built by `buildModeratorBlocks` in [speaker-agreement.ts](src/lib/speaker-agreement.ts) (dynamic strings HTML-escaped — a malicious topic title can't inject), empty for non-moderators. Rides everywhere the speaker context does: bulk sends + the single-send route (incl. its `renderMessageValue` rawHtmlKeys so the token typed into a compose box resolves), the agreement-page merge map (plain-text policy like presentationDetails), `DEFAULT_RAW_HTML_KEYS`, the TEMPLATE_VARIABLES reference, preview samples, and the real-data preview layer (a representative moderator's actual run-sheet). +40 tests across the day (suite → 3307). Verified per phase: tsc/eslint/vitest/build green.

- **Agreement PDF letterhead images + single-signer e-sign block (July 17, 2026, organizer request)** — The generated **speaker** and **presenter** agreement PDFs (the inline HTML→PDF paths) each carry an optional **header + footer banner pair** drawn edge-to-edge on **every page** (letterhead style), and the signature block is now **signer-only** — the Organizer name/line is gone from BOTH PDFs, replaced by a single Speaker/Presenter block with ~64pt of blank space above the line so the signer can insert an **e-signature** (Adobe Fill & Sign etc.; the returned signed copy is stored via the July-16 SpeakerDocument card). **Storage:** 4 new nullable `Event` columns (`speakerAgreementPdfHeaderImage`/`FooterImage` + `presenterAgreementPdf*`; additive+idempotent migration `20260717050000_add_agreement_pdf_images`) — the two agreements' pairs are fully independent, and the presenter agreement's *content* was already its own field (`abstractTermsHtml`, the "Presenter Agreement" card under Setup → Content). **Upload:** `POST/DELETE /api/events/[eventId]/agreement-pdf-images` (`scope=speaker|presenter` + `slot=header|footer`; `denyReviewer`, 20/hr/user, audited) → shared `saveAgreementPdfImage`/`deleteAgreementPdfImage` in [speaker-agreement.ts](src/lib/speaker-agreement.ts) — **PNG/JPEG enforced by magic bytes** (pdfkit cannot embed WebP), 2MB cap, dimension probe (`probeImageDimensions` — PNG IHDR + JPEG SOF walk), files under `/uploads/agreements/{eventId}/` with guarded previous-file cleanup (shared `unlinkAgreementUpload`, also dedup'd into the .docx save path). **Render:** `renderAgreementHtmlToPdf` takes `headerImage`/`footerImage` — placement computed BEFORE the doc exists (image height drives page margins; - **Dinner RSVP ROUND 2 review + full MED remediation (July 16, 2026)** — An independent second pass over the Dinner RSVP module (3 adversarial lenses, deduped against Round 1's [CODE_REVIEW_SURVEY_RSVP.html](docs/CODE_REVIEW_SURVEY_RSVP.html), whose H2/B2/H4/H5 fixes were re-verified to HOLD): **0 BLOCKER / 0 HIGH / 12 MED / 16 LOW**, report at [docs/CODE_REVIEW_DINNER_RSVP_R2.html](docs/CODE_REVIEW_DINNER_RSVP_R2.html). **All 12 MEDs + 7 LOW riders shipped same-day in 4 gated batches** (+15 tests, suite → 3246). **(1) Public-submit correctness (`2716baf7` — M1/M2/M3/M10 + L7/L11/L13):** a dinner with **no `rsvpDeadline` never closed** — the optional-field default meant the roster stayed editable weeks after the gala; the effective close is now `rsvpDeadline ?? dinnerAt` (new `isDinnerOpen`, both GET + POST). An answer for a dinner that closed while the form sat open was **silently dropped behind `ok:true`** — the API now returns `ignoredDinnerIds` and the form warns which answers were NOT recorded. A **stale form addressing zero open dinners** used to run the destructive replace-all anyway (wiping a fresher tab's answers, stamping RESPONDED) — now 409 `STALE_FORM` + auto-reload; decline-all unaffected. The public submit now writes a **before→after AuditLog row with IP** (`action: RESPOND`, `actor: INVITEE` — the speaker-agreement-acceptance shape), so a disputed "I confirmed with 3 guests" is resolvable. Riders: deadline-after-dinner rejected on POST + partial PUT (effective merged values); venue-NAT-safe public submit limits (per-IP 120/hr + per-token 20/hr); dinner UPDATE/DELETE + invite DELETE audits carry real snapshots (were field-names-only / `{}`). **(2) Access alignment (`3966a6d4` — M4/M5/L9):** `GET /dinners` had **no role guard + hand-rolled `organizationId!`** (CRM_USER / cross-event ONSITE could read any org event's dinner config — the class the roster GET's H2 fix missed); now `denyReviewer` + `buildEventAccessWhere`. **MEMBER could read the full VIP roster (names/emails/dietary) through the in-app agent's `list_dinner_rsvps`** — list_-prefixed, so it tunneled through the read-only gate around the H2 policy; new `ROSTER_PII_AGENT_TOOLS` set in [tools/_shared.ts](src/lib/agent/tools/_shared.ts), refused in the agent execute route with `ROSTER_FORBIDDEN` (the FINANCE_ONLY pattern; API-key MCP callers are admin-equivalent, unchanged). All six organizer handlers now resolve the event via `buildEventAccessWhere` (org-null SUPER_ADMIN no longer 404s). **(3) Send-pipeline parity (`c54addef` — M6/M7/M8 + L1/L15):** batch sends are **retry-safe** — the EmailLog rows the route already writes are the resume state (invitees successfully mailed in the last 10 min are skipped with `skippedRecentlyInvited` reported; single-invitee sends are explicit resends, never skipped), so a mid-loop timeout + retry can't re-blast the VIP list. The shared **email-preview route now renders the typed Subject and feeds the typed Message to BOTH `{{message}}` and `{{personalMessage}}`** (the dinner preview used to show the canned "We're excited to have you!" instead of the organizer's text). The send route got the July-16 **`renderMessageValue`** wiring (tokens typed into the Message box resolve per recipient). Riders: "Sent 0, N failed" toasts red; zero-dinner sends refused (400 `NO_DINNERS`). **(4) Honesty + records (`e41d4692` — M9/M11/M12 + L2/L16):** MCP `inviteesTruncated` no longer hard-codes false under a status filter (compares against the FILTERED total); a failed event fetch on the console no longer lets Copy-link hand out a broken `/e//rsvp/…` URL with a green toast; the import dialog toasts on fetch failure instead of "No people found."; and the **doc drift on a security statement** was corrected — RSVP.md's "MEMBER can read the roster" (the OPPOSITE of the enforced model since H2) superseded, this file's "NOT yet independently reviewed" line + DOMAIN_MAP's scoreboard fixed. **Remaining LOWs** (L3 bucket-burn-before-ownership, L4 CRLF, L5 token-in-EmailLog-body, L6 console TZ race, L8 isActive unreachable, L10 CSV name collisions, L12 missing PUT/DELETE rate limits, L14 CSV bare-href) tracked in [docs/ROADMAP.md](docs/ROADMAP.md) §"Dinner RSVP — backlog". Verified per batch: tsc/eslint/vitest/build green.

- **July-16 review remediation round 1 — H1 + M1/M2/M3 + M9/M10/L7 shipped (July 16, 2026)** — The owner-picked first tranche from [docs/CODE_REVIEW_JULY16_PROGRAM_COMMS.html](docs/CODE_REVIEW_JULY16_PROGRAM_COMMS.html) (the post-ship review of the same-day program/comms/speaker-documents batch), three gated commits. **(1) H1 (`e795e829`) — the M9 date guard no longer locks Settings → General.** The guard keyed on field *presence*, and the General form always echoes startDate/endDate/timezone back — so an event with a legacy out-of-range session couldn't save a rename/venue/tax change. It now fires only on a **computed change** (`getTime()`/timezone diff vs the stored row) and **excludes CANCELLED sessions** (they no longer render on the agenda and must not block a legitimate date change). **(2) Agreement-link semantics (`a9fdabe7`, M1/M2/M3).** `mintSpeakerAgreementLink` gained `{ rotate }`: **strict AGREEMENT sends keep rotate** (latest re-send wins), **agreementBlock-driven sends (invitation/custom, incl. `includeAgreementLink`) mint ADDITIVELY** — sweeping only expired rows — so a bounced invitation or two same-minute scheduled sends can never invalidate a previously-delivered agreement link (tokens are stored hashed, so literal reuse is impossible; additive minting is the equivalent guarantee). Acceptance now `deleteMany`s ALL of the speaker's tokens (no valid sibling survives a signing; a stale link post-acceptance still lands on the friendly `alreadyAccepted` state). **M3 cross-caller parity:** bulk AGREEMENT re-sends to a *signed* speaker used to render a dead `href=""` CTA while single-send minted a working link — bulk strict sends now mint for everyone (landing signed speakers on the already-accepted page; `{{agreementBlock}}` still renders the green note). **M2 disclosure:** the bulk dialog (speaker invitation) + the speaker page's invitation dialog now say the agreement block adds a personal Review & Agree link (previous links stay valid) + attaches the personalized agreement when configured; the strict agreement dialog states re-sending REPLACES the previous link. **(3) Timezone/labels sweep (`f056daab`, M9/M10/L7).** The five surfaces the July-16 agenda unification missed now render in the **event's** timezone with a label: speaker detail page (sessions + topics + its SessionDetailSheet mount), the speakers-list quick-view sheet, **webinar confirmation/reminder emails** (`{{webinarDate}}`/`{{webinarTime}}` rendered the server's UTC clock — a 10:00 Dubai webinar emailed "06:00 AM UTC"), the **`{sessionDateTime}` merge field inside the personalized agreement document** (was Dubai-fixed `formatDateTime`), and **dinner RSVP** (public invitee page + organizer console — the console's datetime-local form also moved onto the event-TZ `localDateTimeInTz`/`wallTimeInTzToDate` inverse pair with the TZ named on the input labels). The speaker page's **fifth hand-rolled SessionRole colour map** (moderator/chairperson colours swapped vs [session-enums](src/lib/session-enums.ts), lowercase labels) replaced with `SESSION_ROLE_COLORS`/`formatSessionRole`; the communications Session Role filter maps over `SESSION_ROLE_OPTIONS` and the bulk-dialog recap prints "Moderator" not raw "MODERATOR". +7 tests (suite → 3157); report pills flipped in place. **Still open from that review:** M4 (same-session abstract-swap false P2002), M5 (SpeakerDocument replace race + orphaned file), M6 (sortOrder tx doesn't serialize under READ COMMITTED), M7 (signed agreements publicly downloadable via `/uploads` — needs an owner call: authed streaming route vs accepted risk), M8 (MCP `update_session` schema omits `topics`), L1–L6, L8.

`cancelRegistration` gets **M2**'s distinct `CANCEL_FAILED_AFTER_REFUND` ("retry the cancel — the refund will not run twice"), **L2**'s nothing-left-to-refund short-circuit (no spurious auto-CN), and the registrations-review **L3** claimed-flag (a lost cancel race no longer writes a phantom audit row); the manual-capture RECOVERY branch takes the row lock before its count check (payments **L4**); a cap-rejected out-of-band webhook CN now fires an admin notification (Jul-7 **L2**). Jul-7 **M3 verified STALE** (`b579bbe` already made the rollback verify-first + guarded-decrement). **Batch C (`8757020d`) — promo + finance UX:** 100%-off promo no longer strands the registrant's own Remove button (renders in the confirmed card while the reg is outstanding); `discountValue` defensively clamped at BOTH apply paths (never a surcharge, percentage ≤ 100) + MCP `update_promo_code` validates the effective type/value pair; branch-owned `replaced` flag; per-email check before the `usedCount` increment on public register; **"Requires approval" checkbox on the registration-TYPE dialog** (was tier-only — a tier-less type couldn't enable PENDING gating from the UI). Jul-7 **M2** (staged-tier reset) + **re-tier L2** verified STALE (the tier picker moved into the edit form; `resolveRepricing` validates the combined type+tier change). **Batch D (`6f772e07`) — payer follow-ups (June-29 backlog):** new **`mergeBillingAccounts()`** (one tx: re-point `Registration.billingAccountId` + `EventBillingAccount` junctions — overlapping attachments dropped, not duplicated — delete the duplicate, clear `needsReview`, MERGE audit with moved counts) + `POST /api/billing-accounts/[id]/merge` (denyReviewer+denyFinance, 30/hr) + per-row **Merge** action with survivor-picker dialog in Settings → Billing; **inline "+ Add a new payer"** on the registration detail sheet's Charge-to reassign picker (same `AddPayerDialog`); **"Payer" column** on the registrations list + CSV (finance-redacted server-side). +17 tests across the batches (suite → 3153); every batch verified tsc/eslint/vitest/build green + deployed. ROADMAP rows struck; fix annotations appended to [CODE_REVIEW_PAYMENTS_REFUNDS.html](docs/CODE_REVIEW_PAYMENTS_REFUNDS.html) + [CODE_REVIEW_REGISTRATIONS_SPEAKERS.html](docs/CODE_REVIEW_REGISTRATIONS_SPEAKERS.html). **Still open in these clusters:** Jul-7 L1 (`refundedAmount` never rebased on re-payment), payments L5 (zero-decimal CN math), Jul-8 M1 (Cancel-&-refund discards staged edits) + L3 (PUT-cancel `expectedUpdatedAt` reliance), promo MEMBER-sees-code product call + CSV/EventsAir `originalPrice` stamping, quick-add-dialog payer picker, payer list filter + needsReview badge, and cluster 4 (concurrency/seat accounting — deferred by owner choice).

- **Per-speaker documents — signed agreement copy + attachments (July 16, 2026, owner request)** — A speaker now carries uploaded files: **(a) the signed agreement copy** the organizer received back (wet signature / emailed PDF) — **one per speaker per event**, a new upload replaces the previous row + file (partial-unique index as the race backstop), and **deliberately independent of `Speaker.agreementAcceptedAt`** (owner decision: storing the file is not accepting the agreement — the "Mark as Accepted" flow is unchanged); **(b) any other documents** (bio doc, CV, …) with an optional label, unlimited. New `SpeakerDocument` model + `SpeakerDocumentKind` enum (additive + idempotent migration `20260716130000_add_speaker_document`; FK cascade from Speaker, SetNull uploader). Routes: `GET/POST /api/events/[eventId]/speakers/[speakerId]/documents` + `DELETE .../documents/[documentId]` — PDF + DOC/DOCX only, **magic-byte validated** (spoofed Content-Type rejected), 10MB cap, 30/hr/user upload limit; writes `denyReviewer`-guarded, the GET additionally allows MEMBER but blocks org-null attendee roles (a SUBMITTER reaching the event via their own speaker linkage must not browse other speakers' files); event lookup via `buildEventAccessWhere`; DELETE binds the row through speaker + event. Files under `/uploads/speaker-docs/{eventId}/` (uuid names; replaced/deleted rows unlink best-effort); uploads + deletes audited, every rejection logged. UI: **Documents card** ([speaker-documents-card.tsx](src/components/speakers/speaker-documents-card.tsx)) on the speaker detail page sidebar below Speaker Agreement — signed-agreement slot (upload/replace/download/delete) + Other-documents list. +16 route tests (suite → 3136). **Also same day:** the speaker **invitation now attaches the personalized agreement when possible** (`3dce8e7a`) — a non-agreement speaker send whose template carries an agreement token (the invitation's `{{agreementBlock}}`) generates + attaches the personalized .docx/PDF; soft semantics (no configured content → CTA-only send, generation failure → best-effort, signed speakers skipped), the strict agreement type unchanged; +6 tests. And the **gating `next build` was added back to the deploy pipeline's ci job** (owner request — minimal edit; the parallel non-gating sourcemaps job keeps the Sentry upload).

- **`{{organizerSignature}}` ships in 22 of 25 default templates (July 16, 2026, owner request — supersedes the same-day "only when used" decision)** — The token is now IN the default template bodies (html + text) of every template except **payment-confirmation / refund-confirmation** (pure transactional, owner exclusion) and **certificate-bundle-delivery** (rendered by the certificate cover pipeline's own token resolver, not renderTemplate vars). Safety rails so no path ever prints the literal token: `organizerSignature` joined `DEFAULT_RAW_HTML_KEYS` (it is always the sender's OWN profile Tiptap HTML — never recipient-controlled); **`renderAndWrap` defaults the var to ""** so automated senders (webinar cron sequence, abstract/submitter confirmations, reviewer notifies, survey thank-you) render NOTHING; `sendRegistrationConfirmation` — the one sender rendering via `renderTemplate` directly — sets its own `""`; the preview/test-send sample vars carry a sample signature. Human-triggered paths (all bulk sends, speaker + registration single-sends) render the real sender's signature as before. New [organizer-signature-token.test.ts](__tests__/lib/organizer-signature-token.test.ts) pins the render-safety pair (empty default ≠ literal token; provided value renders raw) AND the full 25-template carry/omit matrix — a future template that forgets the token fails the suite. Future nicety (not built): threading the ACTOR's real signature into the reviewer-assignment / abstract-status notify helpers (renders empty there today). +29 tests; tsc/eslint/vitest 3120/build green.
- **Scheduled-email ownership token + mid-send cancel (comms C1+C5) + contacts honest saves (R2-M3/M4) (July 16, 2026)** — Two deferred clusters from the day's reviews, shipped together. **(1) C1 — ownership, not just liveness:** new `ScheduledEmail.claimToken` (additive+idempotent migration `20260716120000`): the worker's PENDING→PROCESSING claim stamps a per-claim token, and the heartbeat + ALL terminal writes (SENT / SENT-0 / FAILED) now condition on `status = PROCESSING AND claimToken = ours` ([scheduled-emails-worker.ts](src/lib/scheduled-emails-worker.ts)) — before this, `status = PROCESSING` alone also matched a row a Retry had re-claimed, so a zombie sender surviving a DB-write outage could mark the re-claimed row SENT with its own counts while worker B was mid-send. Retry clears the token. **(2) C5 — a mid-flight send can be stopped:** `executeBulkEmail` + `executeCertificateBulkSend` take a `shouldContinue` callback checked between every 25-recipient batch (the worker's check = "still PROCESSING with MY token"); the schedule DELETE now cancels **PROCESSING** rows too — a mistaken 2,000-recipient send stops at the next batch boundary instead of running to completion. An aborted send returns `aborted: true`, writes NO terminal state, fires no audit/notify, and everything already sent stays in `emailedKeys` so a later Retry resumes rather than re-sends; a THROWING check means keep-going (a pooler blip must not kill a live send). MCP `cancel_scheduled_email` deliberately stays PENDING-only. **(3) Contacts honest saves:** `additionalEmail` added to the contacts update schema (it was in NEITHER schema, so the detail sheet's field was a dead write — success toast, value reverted; empty string → null clears), and the [contact detail sheet](src/components/contacts/contact-detail-sheet.tsx) now sends `value || null` for every optional field so an emptied phone/org/bio/notes actually CLEARS (half the fields previously sent `|| undefined` = "unchanged" — and the only other clearing surface, the full-page edit form, was itself broken until this morning's H-B fix). +24 tests (claim-token stamping + same-token completion, zombie/abort no-terminal-write, shouldContinue truth table, 26-recipient batch-boundary abort with resume-keys, throwing-check keep-going, additionalEmail persist/clear/reject + null-clear PUT). tsc/eslint/vitest 3085/build green.
- **Invitation + agreement merged via {{agreementBlock}} + sent-email paragraph spacing fix (July 16, 2026, owner requests)** — **(1) {{agreementBlock}}** (`a44273fe`): the speaker-invitation email now carries a one-liner about the speaker agreement + a **"Review & Agree" CTA button**, exposed as the pre-rendered `{{agreementBlock}}`/`{{agreementBlockText}}` template variables (added to the default invitation template; customized templates opt in by adding the token; the separate agreement email type stays for re-sends — owner decision: enrich, not replace). ONE implementation for both send paths in [speaker-agreement.ts](src/lib/speaker-agreement.ts): `mintSpeakerAgreementLink()` (extracted from the single-send route's inline token rotation — delete+create tx, 30-day expiry), `buildAgreementBlock()` (three states: unsigned → CTA; **already signed → green "already accepted" note, never re-asked**; no link → empty), and `templateUsesAgreementBlock()` which **gates the mint** — a link is minted only when the resolved template actually uses an agreement token, so an unrelated send never rotates (invalidates) a previously-emailed agreement link. **Also fixed a latent bulk bug found while wiring: bulk AGREEMENT sends never minted `{{agreementLink}}`** — the default agreement template's CTA button href stayed the literal token on every bulk agreement send; the bulk pipeline now mints per recipient (failure isolated per row). `agreementBlock` joined `DEFAULT_RAW_HTML_KEYS`; preview sample vars added. +11 tests. **(2) Paragraph spacing** (`5ac09e7a`, organizer-reported "space between two p tags"): the Tiptap editor emits one `<p>` per Enter and shows a 16px bottom margin, but the branding wrapper shipped **no paragraph CSS**, so email clients applied their default 1em top+bottom margins to every `<p>` — roughly double the gap the organizer saw in the editor. `wrapWithBranding`'s head now carries `p { margin: 0 0 16px 0; }`, inlined by juice at send time; explicit inline margins in template markup still win. +2 tests. tsc/eslint/vitest 3076/build green.

- **Program/agenda deferred-findings batch — 9 conference items shipped in 3 phases (July 16, 2026)** — The non-webinar remainder of the July 10 program/agenda review's deferred list (ROADMAP §"Program / agenda / sessions review"), shipped as three gated commits. **(1) Timezone cluster (`15bb3e88` — M7/M8 + the L4 countdown half).** The public agenda + registration-page preview bucketed days in the *viewer's* timezone while rendering times in the *event's* (an 11 PM event-TZ session landed under the next day's heading for viewers west of the event) — day buckets now use `localDateInTz(event.timezone)`.
